hardware.variant: CIX P1 CD8180; 32 GB; stock BiosV1.5-W20260706-e321056a; no RTC backup battery

scenario: Set the system time with date(1), so that the kernel writes it through EFI SetTime. Remove input power, restore it, and boot the same kernel without network time.
expected: The kernel reads a time within one second of a reference clock and reports no lost clock.
observed: The kernel used EFI runtime services for the RTC, and the ACPI RTC0 (RX008900) node stayed unconfigured. After boot, the board clock was 0.08 s behind the reference host. The kernel printed no clock-lost warning.
limits: One power removal of short, unrecorded length.
No battery was connected to the RTC connector. A later removal lost the time (efi-rtc-power-removal-no-battery).
The reference was a networked host compared over SSH, not a disciplined time source.
The kernel truncates the RTC seconds on read, so one boot can lose up to one second.
